question: In a certain code language, ‘SAVE’ is coded as ‘522119’. How will ‘WEAK’ be coded in that language?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png]

So,

 
• SAVE is c
